name: mio-report-limited36-available-size-20261029
notes: ADR-0283 run report for the verified limited36 available-size MIO run: four methods, one report each. Renders SAVED output only (no run, fit or pull): table-file reads result.json by sha256, MioRunRows restates a method as event rows, RowsToEvents maps them, EventTotalsGate refuses unless event net P&L and final equity equal the saved ones to the cent, EvaluationReport writes summary.md, report.html and CSVs to a fresh report-only directory under /home/russell/data/index_options/mio-run-report-limited36-20261029. Four branches because one report is one account and each method is its own. Glossary: children/index_options/docs/explanations/mio-glossary.md. stress_links.params.root is a placeholder until the v4 stress output root is named; a missing root renders pending. Each method's report carries its own ArtifactLinks node (the same root and grid).

params.source: verified limited36 MIO available-size run output (ADR-0281/0282 Amendment 1), read only

result.notes: The method results this report restates; pinned by sha256.

nominal_lp_rows.notes: Restates the saved method result as event rows: each book is one unit bought at -premium (+ saved fees) on fill_date and sold at pnl - credit on close_date; refusals keep their saved reason.

nominal_lp_solve_rows.notes: Decisions that carry solver certificates; mapping.explode refuses a row without the field, so empty-certificate decisions are dropped here.

run_start.title: MIO limited36 available-size run report: nominal_lp

nominal_lp_events.notes: Event equity between a fill and its expiry is at cost (the unit is held at its premium); the marked daily curve is the day-by-day ledger table.

nominal_lp_gate.notes: Exact-match gate (ADR-0283): refuses, and no report is written, unless the events' net P&L, final equity, contributions and fees equal the pinned result.json's for this method to the cent, and the event counts (fills, refusals, decisions) equal the saved ones. The net P&L is built from the saved per-book pnl, so the gate proves the event book reproduces the saved totals and counts, not an independent settlement.

ledger.title: Day-by-day ledger (marked daily curve)
ledger.note: One row per account session. Cash, reserve, funding, equity, nav and drawdown are the run's saved MARKED daily curve; the other columns join that day's attempted, filled and refused books and the books expiring.

marked-figures.title: Saved marked figures (authoritative)
marked-figures.note: From the pinned result.json, never recomputed. The event-based statistics above (TWR, drawdown, Sharpe) value an open book at cost between its fill and expiry, so they differ from twr and max_drawdown here; the MIO marked figures are authoritative. See children/index_options/docs/explanations/mio-glossary.md.

gate-comparison.title: Exact-match gate: events against the saved result
gate-comparison.note: expected is result.json's value; actual is recomputed from the events. Net P&L is built from the saved per-book pnl, so this proves the event book reproduces the saved totals and counts, not an independent settlement.

ticker-dte.title: Filled books by ticker and DTE

refusals-ticker-dte.title: Fill-stage refusals by ticker, DTE and reason
refusals-ticker-dte.note: Books selected by a decision but refused at the next session's fill. Decision-stage refusals have no DTE and sit in the decision log.

nominal_lp_report.notes: Plain-language terms: children/index_options/docs/explanations/mio-glossary.md. Simulated EOD displayed-depth fills, not broker liquidity or proof of profitability.
